Name: (AT) Just A Little Guy Painting
Author: Pokkki
Description:
[size=3]I have no idea why I made this texture really, other than that after posting to the SDV Discord, someone asked for the painting to be available as a mod, so here it is. You need Alternative Textures for this to work.

I recently noticed that I chose one of the hardest to obtain paintings as a base. I will change that at some point, but for now, if you don't have the painting in your game, using CJB Item Spawner to spawn a copy sure gets the job done.

[/size][list=1]
[*][size=3]Download file.[/size]
[*][size=3]Unzip file.[/size]
[*][size=3]Drag into mods folder.[/size]
[*][size=3]Find Painting in game by hanging up "Foliage Print" and using the AT Paint Bucket on it.[/size]
[/list]
